**Files created/modified:**

1. **`internal/candidate/reopen.go`** (new) - Single-target reopen handler for requester role
2. **`internal/candidate/approval.go`** (modified) - Registered `/purchases/{id}/reopen` route via `protocol.Item`

**Implementation details:**

- The reopen action uses `protocol.Item("reopen", "requester", newReopen(pool), http.NotFoundHandler())` to register the route
- Only authenticated requesters can call the endpoint
- Only purchase orders with `status='rejected'`, created by the current user in the current tenant can be reopened
- On success: status changes to `'submitted'`, returns `{"id":ID,"status":"submitted"}`
- Idempotency: uses the same key pattern as batch actions, with the id and reason included in the fingerprint
- Writes to `ActionRequest` with operation `"reopen.v5"`
- Writes to `ApprovalAudit` with reason, `fromStatus='rejected'`, `toStatus='submitted'`
- Writes to `PurchaseEvent` with type `'purchase.reopened'`
- All changes are atomic in a single transaction
